messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: Sev2 - model-serving runtime container restart storm on cluster gpu-pool-3 (alert id PD-59211)
Mira (oncall): I'm seeing ~40% of replicas in model-serving namespace in CrashLoopBackOff on nodes gpu-3a/gpu-3b, customers complaining about timeouts. starting triage. @Liam can you join?
Liam (eng-runtime): joining. quick ask: is this vLLM-based runtime or a custom TRT build?
Mira (oncall): it's our custom runtime (trt-llm-optimized) on 2.1.3 image. recent deploy rolled earlier today at 07:20 UTC.
Anya (eng-sre): I'm pulling kube events now. nodes show OOMKilled then immediate CrashLoopBackOff. Kubelet logs show container exited with signal 11.
Liam (eng-runtime): signal 11 -> SIGSEGV. can you grab a container log + core dump if present?
DevOps-Bot: Automated action: collecting pod logs and /var/log/messages from affected nodes. artifacts: https://internal.artifacts/redwood/incidents/2098761234/logbundle.tar.gz
Mira (oncall): attaching tail of one pod log: ```2026-03-14T07:45:12Z INFO loading model shard 3
2026-03-14T07:45:12Z INFO allocating GPU memory 13.4G
2026-03-14T07:45:13Z ERROR runtime: failed in cuda kernel invoke: cuLaunchKernel returned 1
2026-03-14T07:45:13Z panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
SIGSEGV: segmentation violation```
Liam (eng-runtime): cuLaunchKernel returned 1 is generic CUDA error (invalid configuration / illegal memory access). follow-up: we'll check whether a recent change to fused attention kernels landed in today's canary.
Anya (eng-sre): Impact: 23% of user-facing routes went 503s over the last 12m; Client A (enterprise) reported degraded inference for batch endpoints. I've opened incident summary for CS.
Priya (support): Client A contacted support with SLA breach potential. They've been routed to our oncall and told we're investigating.
Liam (eng-runtime): I can reproduce locally with a smaller trace; looks like a path in the custom CUDA attention that dereferences a stale pointer when sequence length > 2048. Not the quant layer. Reproducer attached (small trace).
Mira (oncall): Immediate mitigation plan?
Liam (eng-runtime): options: 1) roll back today's runtime image to yesterday's stable build (safe, fast), 2) hotpatch the kernel to add bounds checks (risky and slower), 3) autoscale away affected nodes and route traffic to Dedicated pool.
Anya (eng-sre): rolling back image is fastest. I'll start a controlled rollback: scale down deployment to 0.5x then update image tag to stable-2.1.2, then scale to X replicas with canary.
Mira (oncall): go for rollback. set canary to 10% then monitor for segfaults. @Sam please prepare to take over in 30m for handoff.
DevOps-Bot: Action started: deployment/model-serving set image trt-llm:stable-2.1.2; scaled canary to 2 replicas.
Liam (eng-runtime): also instrumented additional logging to capture kernel launch parameters and sequence length; will push as non-breaking env var so it doesn't affect performance.
Anya (eng-sre): after rollback, crash rate dropped to <1% within 90s on canary. scaling to full traffic in progress.
Mira (oncall): rolling to full now. keeping monitoring window open 15m. collecting golden traces for postmortem.
Priya (support): Notified Client A: we deployed rollback and are seeing recovery; offering post-incident postmortem and ETA for fix.
Liam (eng-runtime): root cause: bad merge in fused attention kernel that didn't handle long sequences for empty KV cache case -> triggered illegal memory access in CUDA. Fix in review MR#4532, adding bounds guards and unit test.
Anya (eng-sre): recovery confirmed across cluster. No ongoing OOMs or segfaults. I'll keep an eye for flapping.
Mira (oncall): handoff to @Sam incoming. Summary: rollback to stable image resolved crashloops; customer impact limited to 12m of degraded responses for some batch endpoints; PD alert cleared. Actions: postmortem with timeline, regression test for long-seq attention, backport hotfix to stable branch, customer-facing RCA draft.
Sam (next-oncall): taking over. I'll run a post-rollback soak for 2h and coordinate the RCA meeting. please drop any remaining artifacts in the incident doc.
Liam (eng-runtime): will merge hotfix and open backport PRs after tests. tagging @Anya for deployment plan.
Mira (oncall): closing pager now. thanks all. :thumbsup:
DevOps-Bot: Incident PD-59211 marked resolved by Mira (oncall) at 2026-03-14T08:15:00Z
